name: Upyr
description: The upyr is the Slavic revenant or blood-drinking undead from which the modern Western 'vampire' concept is descended; a corpse that rises from the grave to attack family, livestock, and community.
origin: Upyr traditions are found across the Slavic world and adjacent regions, from East Slavic (Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian) through West Slavic (Polish, Czech, Slovak, Sorbian) to South Slavic (Serbian, Bulgarian, Macedonian) cultures. Closely related traditions exist among Romanians (strigoi), Greeks (vrykolakas), Albanians (shtriga), and Turkic-speaking peoples (ubir).
